reason: ₹22,000 is more than a month and a half of everything we earn, and a plain semi-automatic in the shop costs about half that. We already wash by hand, so I can't spend that much just so a load finishes when the light goes.
objection: It costs double a normal washer, and ₹2,000 every month for a year is too much for us. If the battery goes bad after three years, I don't know what it will cost to replace.
would_change_my_mind: If it cost close to a normal semi-automatic, around ₹11,000, or the EMI was ₹700-800 a month, I would think about it.
